name: Custom Wheel Spinner
description:
FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:

Crafted from high-quality, durable plywood, this wheel spinner is made up of multiple precisely cut wooden panels:

 - Panel 1, 4, 5: Single-layer wood (0.3 cm thick)

 - Panel 2 (pointer): Three-layer construction for extra stability (2 layers of 0.3 cm + 1 layer of 0.4 cm wood)

 - Panel 3 (Base): Two-layer wooden base for solid support (each layer 0.3 cm thick)

Assembled with a secure metal screw button for smooth rotation.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions:

The product is available in various components and assembled sizes. Fully assembled spinner size:

 - 6 x 6 inches ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm

 - 8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm

 - 10 x 10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm

Base dimensions: Ranges from 4.92 x 12.5 cm to 7.92 x 18.33 cm depending on version.

Individual pieces: Detailed measurements are provided in the third image, including arm length, panel width, and base slots.

 

  • Printing Technology:

Printed with high-resolution UV printing on both sides.

Ensures vibrant, sharp, and fade-resistant images.

Each emotion icon includes expressive facial features and clear text, making it engaging and easy to understand.

 

  • Functionality & Usage:

Features a 360° rotatable pointer to easily indicate your current feeling.

Includes 8 common emotions such as happy, sad, angry, sleepy, hungry, bored, sick, and surprised.

Perfect for:

 - Emotional learning and expression (for children and adults)

 - Classroom activities, therapy sessions.

 - Daily check-in boards at home or school.

 

  • A Thoughtful Gift for Any Occasions:

A versatile gift suitable for kids, teachers, therapists, parents, or coworkers.

Ideal for Christmas, birthdays, Thanksgiving, back-to-school, Teacher’s Day, or any special occasion.

Promotes emotional well-being and communication in a fun and interactive way.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Wheel Spinner

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
